blocks.content: The Constitution is not a mere lawyers' document, it is a vehicle of Life, and its spirit is always the spirit of Age.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constituent Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to draft the Constitution of India.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee and is recognized as the chief architect of the Constitution.
The idea to form a Constituent Assembly was first put forward by M.N. Roy in 1934.
The original Constitution contained 395 Articles divided into 22 Parts and 8 Schedules.
Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946.
Article 32 was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'.
The terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976.
Fundamental Duties were added under Article 51A in Part IV-A based on the Swaran Singh Committee recommendations.
The concept of Fundamental Rights was borrowed from the US Constitution, while the Cabinet system was borrowed from the British Constitution.
